notes.title: Endless Engines Patch 1.2.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey, I caught a few bugs after the update launch.  I’m going to release this small patch to squash them.

Bug Fixes/Tweaks:
Bug fixed where old asset for main menu button appears when clicking button during Victory Cutscene.
Fixed bug where Conbuffder destroyed tiles from his room during his boss fight.

notes.title: Endless Engines 1.2 Update Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello passengers!

The Endless Engines 1.2 Update is now here!   This update adds some much needed quality of life improvements to the game, like our brand new sound adjustment menu, as well as adds Steam Achievements to the game for the first time! 

I hope you enjoy it.

Updated:

#Title Screen:
Key Art Changed.

#Shopkeepers:
Shopkeeper Portraits Added.
Shop car assets updated.
After-Boss Shop text is now shorter.

#Pause Menu:
Pause Menu Background Updated.

#Game Over:
New "Play Again" Button.
Buttons replaced and text added for clarity.

Bug Fixes/Tweaks:
#Bugs:
Bug fixed where Soda Bottle/Laser Pointer weapons didn't extend fully.
Bug fixed where the background for the Choo Choo Crew boss did not appear during the boss fight.
Bug fixed where the Victory Cutscene had trouble playing.

Adjusted volume level of bottle shatter and other loud sound effects to save your ears.
Small texture fixes and color adjustments.
Fixed text errors in shopkeeper text and weapon descriptions.

Removed:
#Train Jockey:
The Train Jockey enemy has been temporarily removed due to a bug and will return in a future update.

notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Now Available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The 1.1.2 patch for Endless Engines is now available!  This is a very small update to our menu scenes.  

Cosmetic changes
- Menu assets updated.
- Minor text changes in the credits scene.

notes.title: 1.1 Launch Update
notes.notes:
- New car type added: Tropical, filled with sand castles and water slimes
- New temporary power ups added including rocket, roller skates, cleats, shell, glasses, magnet, butter, and boosts to elemental weapons 
- Chest rarities added
- Enemies can now drop a random item instead of one prefixed item
- Splash screen and game icon added 
- General bug fixes and gameplay improvements
